Topic trends over time

Source: R/trends.R
topic_trends.Rd

Average share of each topic among the abstracts published in each year (or group of years). Shares in a period add up to 1.

Usage

topic_trends(model, data, year = "year", bin = 1, n_terms = 3)

Arguments

model

A model from [topic_model()].

data

The same data frame that was passed to [topic_model()].

year

Name of the column holding the publication year.

bin

Width of each period in years.

n_terms

Number of top words shown in each topic's label.

Value

A data frame with `period`, `topic`, `label`, `share` (average share of an abstract) and `n_period` (abstracts in the period).
